title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 16, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.5 (Peaked November 16, 2026 at 19:45 UTC)

🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Image: NASA SDO — AIA 171 Å + HMI Magnetic Polarity
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
